Anarchy Audio Australia browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive browse by enclosure pedal events NAMM NAMM 2018 Anarchy Audio Australia Deadwoods - Chainsaw Fuzz Published on February 8, 2018 Anarchy Audio Australia distortion/fuzz/overdrive pedal NAMM 2018 Information Anarchy Audio Australia Deadwoods pays homage to two cult Japanese chainsaw circuits, the Boss HM2 Heavy Metal and the Shinei FY2 Companion Fuzz. The result is a nasty, chainsaw square wave fuzz with an active EQ section, capable of boosting and pummelling your gain stage into a pulp. Suitable for both electric downtuned guitars and bass.
